100K black text over Warm Orange. Top line overprints, bottom line knocks out.

Registration is the discipline of making separate plates land in exactly the same place. A press does not know what a brochure is; it knows four inks and, sometimes, a fifth. This paragraph is set in one hundred percent black and nothing else, so it must appear on the black plate alone. If any cyan, magenta or yellow leaks into these letters, the text will fringe on press, and fine serifs will look dirty. Sentinel colors let the browser lay out every glyph while the prepress stage chooses the ink.
